correctness.rationale: In the bi-infinite extension any two specified cyclic edge types, even two copies of one type, can be realized disjointly by translation. Thus admissibility is exactly exclusion of all four self-dual edges and simultaneous use of either pair of distinct reverse-complement edge types; this also treats n=1,2. The pairwise indicator expansion is exact, the trace of each surviving adjacency matrix counts positioned closed walks, and the formal trace-determinant identity gives the signed determinant product. Independently, review_checks/periodic_alphabet_certificate.py built the union of the 64 maximal graphs by successive inclusion-exclusion and extracted determinants by trace/Newton identities: all 18 signed nonzero entries and the exact cross-multiplied identity agreed. It reproduced the first 18 counts from the product and direct word/rotation-class counts through length 8. Burnside applies because repeating a block does not change the bi-infinite extension; the divisor formula counts fixed words rather than just primitive periods. The cubic has one simple root alpha>2 and the other roots in (-1,0) and (0,1); the other factors have reciprocal roots of modulus at most 2 (in particular |x|>2 is impossible for x^4-x^3-1=0). Logarithmic differentiation gives multiplicity eight and O(2^n), and proper-period divisor terms are O(n alpha^(n/2)) before division by n.
residual_risks: This counts bi-infinite periodic extensions, not disjoint arcs confined to one finite traversal or finite linear words; there is no physical biochemistry claim.

value.rationale: This is the fixed-point zeta function of a natural periodic four-letter avoidance language, not a rerun of the finite-linear capacity computation. The compatible graphs have overlapping cycle languages, and even the leading multiplicity is not supplied by optimizing a spectral radius. The simplified rational invariant resolves the all-length census and determines both positioned words and rotation classes, useful when counting or comparing periodic constraint languages.
residual_risks: Burnside, finite-matrix trace identities and the capacity alone are not credited as new; value is confined to the exact periodic invariant of this language.
